description:
Veteran Refits
Your ships earn XP in combat. Spend it on extra S-mod slots, then build in S-mods with credits instead of story points.

Requires LunaLib

Authors note
I've been a long time Starsector player and this is my first mod for the game. I really enjoy tinkering with Ships and have almost always played with the great Progressive S-Mods, but I've always felt like something is missing with the mod so I decided to make a spin on it. It's heavily influenced by PSM but does most things differently.

Thank you for reading and thanks to the modding community for countless hours of content for this game.

About
Veteran Refits gives your ships combat experience. A ship that fights earns XP. Spend that XP to raise the ship's S-mod limit, then build in or remove S-mods for credits.
Vanilla's story-point build-in still works. This mod adds a second way to get S-mods.

Features

Ship XP from combat. Deployed ships earn XP for the hull damage they deal and for the enemy ships they help knock out. Ships in reserve get a share, and a deployed ship never earns less than that share.
Extra S-mod slots. Spend a ship's XP to raise its S-mod limit. The raised limit also shows in the vanilla refit screen.
Build in and remove S-mods for credits, in a dialog styled after vanilla's build-in dialog. It also handles:
enhancing built-in hullmods that have an S-mod effect, like vanilla
modules of multi-section ships (each module may use up to the main ship's limit)
removing S-mods for a fee (the bought slot stays)

Upgrade indicators. A green arrow on refit ship cards marks ships that can buy their next slot. After each battle, a report lists the XP each ship earned and which ships have an upgrade available.
Everything is configurable in LunaLib's mod settings, and changes apply without a restart.

Screenshots

Spoiler

How to use
Open the refit screen and press Ship upgrades under vanilla's Build in button (hotkey S). It also appears in the add-hullmod picker and in LunaLib's refit button list.

Buy a slot: spend the ship's XP on an extra S-mod slot. This works anywhere.
Build in or remove: tick hullmods in the table, then press Confirm (G). You must be docked at a market, and it costs credits.

Installation

Install LunaLib.
Download Veteran-Refits-1.0.0.zip from GitHub Releases.
Unzip it into Starsector/mods/, so you get mods/Veteran Refits/mod_info.json.
Enable Veteran Refits and LunaLib in the launcher.

Save compatibility

Can be added to an existing save.
Can't be removed from a save. A hidden hullmod is stored on your ships to apply the extra slots.

Compatibility

Don't use it together with Progressive S-Mods. Both raise the same S-mod limit stat.
The refit button and the ship card icons reach into the game's refit UI through reflection. If a game update breaks that, they switch off and log an error. The entry in LunaLib's refit button list keeps working.

AI content disclaimer
This mod was made with an AI coding assistant, Claude (Anthropic), used through Claude Code.

Me: designed the mod, decided its features and balance, and tested every change in game.
Claude: wrote most of the code, based on my design, feedback and in-game screenshots.

Credits and permissions
Some techniques were learned from reading these mods. No code was copied.

LunaLib by Lukas04: the refit button and panel API, the mod settings, and the workaround for reflection into the game's UI.
Progressive S-Mods by qcwxezda and chdcl: the original idea of earning S-mods through ship XP, raising the S-mod limit with a hidden hullmod, and its build-in rules.
Exiled Sector by Portals: placing a button under vanilla's "Build in" button, and the refit screen's frame measurements.

Permissions: the code is under the MIT license. You're free to reuse, modify and redistribute it, as long as the license notice is kept.

Bug reports and balance feedback are welcome in this thread or on GitHub. If something breaks, please attach your starsector.log.
